title: Heavenly Sixteen All-In-One Face Oil
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Hydrating✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Loss of firmness✓ Plumping
What it is: A restorative blend of 16 non-comedogenic, vegan oils to intensely condition, visibly plump, and boost the look of skin’s elasticity.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, and Loss of Firmness and Elasticity

Formulation: Oil

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Meadowfoam, Hemp, Sunflower, Cranberry, Olive, Broccoli, and Grapeseed Oils: Infuse skin with intense, soothing moisture.
- Blackcurrant, Tsubaki, Sacha Inchi, and Sea Buckthorn Oils: Replenish, visibly plump, and reduce the look of fine lines.
- Prickly Pear, Cucumber, Rosehip, Watermelon, and Pomegranate Oils: Support a strong skin barrier and protect against free-radical damage.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Gently smooth over skin as the final step in your routine.
-You can also add one to two drops to your favorite moisturizer for a boost of hydration.

Recycling Instructions:
-Upon unboxing, please flatten the unit carton and liner, then place in the recycling bin.
-Once your bottle is empty, remove the dropper and discard.
-Rinse the glass bottle to remove any excess product and place in the recycling bin.
Ingredients+
-Meadowfoam, Hemp, Sunflower, Cranberry, Olive, Broccoli, and Grapeseed Oils: Infuse skin with intense, soothing moisture.
-Blackcurrant, Tsubaki, Sacha Inchi, and Sea Buckthorn Oils: Replenish, visibly plump, and reduce the look of fine lines.
-Prickly Pear, Cucumber, Rosehip, Watermelon, and Pomegranate Oils: Support a strong skin barrier and protect against free-radical damage.

Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Vitus Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Limnanthes Alba (Meadowfoam) Seed Oil, Rosa Canina Seed Oil, Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Oil, Squalane, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Tocopherol, Plukenetia Volubilis Seed Oil, Vaccinium Macrocarpon (Cranberry) Seed Oil, Punica Granatum Seed Oil, Ribes Nigrum (Black Currant) Seed Oil, Camellia Japonica Seed Oil, Brassica Oleracea Italica (Broccoli) Seed Oil, Opuntia Ficus-Indica Seed Oil, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Seed Oil, Citrullus Lanatus (Watermelon) Seed Oil, Cannabis Sativa Seed Oil, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract.



The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
